summary: This is a Mol Labs public report (card L24) proposing a research hypothesis and experimental design to test whether canagliflozin's longevity/healthspan benefits are SGLT2-dependent or retain residual efficacy under SGLT2 genetic loss-of-function (LOF) or matched SGLT2-block. The document is a pre-registered research discussion card (status: NEGATIVE/NOT_RUN) that identifies existing literature priors (Miller ITP, Vallon Sglt2 KO, Jayarathne, Snyder) and explicitly marks the key residual-positive H2H experiment as UNKNOWN and unperformed. No new experimental data are generated; the document proposes an assay design and prediction framework for a future rodent study.

content_blocks.title: Hypothesis / Claim Overview
content_blocks.content: The central claim (L24) asks whether canagliflozin retains lifespan/healthspan phenotype on a pre-registered rodent metabolic/healthspan panel when SGLT2-class longevity attribution is abolished via Sglt2/SGLT2 genetic LOF or matched SGLT2-block. The primary prediction gate is: under the block lock, same-panel early healthspan/metabolic improvement (canagliflozin vs vehicle under block) retains ≥50% of the canagliflozin vs vehicle early healthspan/metabolic improvement on SGLT2-intact concurrent controls. Residual-positive lifespan or healthspan H2H under SGLT2 abolish is explicitly marked UNKNOWN. Longevity-class necessity AGAINST residual is also UNKNOWN. The document explicitly prohibits inventing residual effect sizes.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art — Miller ITP (PMID 32990681)
content_blocks.content: Miller JCI Insight 2020 (PMID 32990681 / DOI 10.1172/jci.insight.140019 / PMC7710304): Canagliflozin extends median lifespan of genetically heterogeneous male UM-HET3 mice by ~14% and 90th-percentile age by ~9% in the ITP three-site study. No lifespan benefit in females despite improved glucose in both sexes. Classified as phenotype longevity prior. Limitation: no Sglt2 genetic LOF or matched SGLT2-block residual lifespan H2H on same panel.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art — Vallon Sglt2 KO Metabolic Tool (PMID 23152292)
content_blocks.content: Vallon Am J Physiol Renal 2013 (PMID 23152292 / DOI 10.1152/ajprenal.00409.2012 / PMC3543626): Gene-targeted Sglt2(−/−) mice — absence of SGLT2 attenuates STZ-induced hyperglycemia and prevents glomerular hyperfiltration but not kidney growth/injury. Classified as genetic LOF metabolic tool for SGLT2 abolish design. Limitation: not a canagliflozin × Sglt2 KO longevity/healthspan residual H2H.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art — Jayarathne Neuroprotection Healthspan (PMID 35707855)
content_blocks.content: Jayarathne Aging Cell 2022 (PMID 35707855 / DOI 10.1111/acel.13653 / PMC9282842): Canagliflozin improves central insulin sensitivity (male) and reduces age-associated hypothalamic gliosis (both sexes) in aged genetically diverse UM-HET3 mice. Classified as healthspan/neuroprotect phenotype prior. Limitation: no Sglt2-abolish residual arm.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art — Snyder Age-Lesion Healthspan (PMID 35974129)
content_blocks.content: Snyder GeroScience 2023 (PMID 35974129 / DOI 10.1007/s11357-022-00641-0 / PMC9886729): Canagliflozin diminishes incidence/severity of cardiomyopathy, glomerulonephropathy, arteriosclerosis, hepatic lipidosis, and adrenal cortical neoplasms in genetically heterogeneous male mice. Classified as healthspan/pathology phenotype prior. Limitation: no Sglt2-abolish residual arm.

content_blocks.title: Proposed Experimental Design
content_blocks.content: Design: Pre-registered rodent metabolic/healthspan panel with canagliflozin vs vehicle under (a) Sglt2/SGLT2 genetic LOF or matched SGLT2-block that abolishes SGLT2-class longevity attribution, and (b) SGLT2-intact concurrent controls on the same panel. Primary referee: pre-specified early healthspan/metabolic endpoint within the refute window. Optional co-readouts: age-lesion / neuroprotect / full lifespan (secondary only, not gate). Optional cell/proximal-tubule metabolic lock only as assay-support. Refute criterion: block-arm early healthspan/metabolic improvement <50% of SGLT2-intact canagliflozin vs vehicle improvement (when block-not-abolished, underpowered-strata, and assay-mismatch artifacts are ruled out). Execution status: NOT_RUN. Estimated time to refute: 6 weeks. Kill cost tier: 2.

content_blocks.title: Mechanism Sketch and Competing Caveats
content_blocks.content: Mechanism framing: sglt2-insufficiency assumption-kill. Miller ITP grounds canagliflozin male UM-HET3 lifespan phenotype without Sglt2-abolish residual arm. Vallon Sglt2(−/−) provides metabolic LOF tool for SGLT2 abolish design — not residual longevity H2H. Jayarathne and Snyder ground neuroprotect/age-lesion healthspan priors without Sglt2-abolish residual arms. Competing caveats: (1) block not actually abolishing SGLT2-class control benefit; (2) underpowered strata; (3) referee-assay mismatch — any of these leave the test inconclusive rather than refuted. Explicit exclusions: SGLT2 ≠ bulk ATG (L20); SGLT2 ≠ mitophagy (L21); SGLT2 ≠ AMPK (L22); SGLT2 ≠ GSK3 (L23); off-panel empa-HF or cana NHE3/mito SGLT2-independent arms ≠ longevity residual proof; NOT NAD-after-senolysis.

content_blocks.content: IP class: sglt2-insufficiency. Kill cost tier: 2. Time to refute: 6 weeks. Vault hold: no. Execution status: NOT_RUN. FTO status: UNKNOWN. Novelty tag: assumption-kill. key_findings: Canagliflozin extends male UM-HET3 median lifespan by ~14% and 90th-percentile age by ~9% in the Miller ITP study (PMID 32990681), but no Sglt2-abolish residual arm exists on the same panel.
Vallon Sglt2(−/−) mice (PMID 23152292) provide a validated genetic LOF metabolic tool for SGLT2 abolish design, but this is not a canagliflozin × Sglt2 KO longevity/healthspan residual H2H.

Jayarathne (PMID 35707855) shows canagliflozin improves central insulin sensitivity (male) and reduces hypothalamic gliosis (both sexes) in aged UM-HET3 — healthspan prior without Sglt2-abolish residual arm.

Snyder (PMID 35974129) shows canagliflozin reduces cardiomyopathy, glomerulonephropathy, arteriosclerosis, hepatic lipidosis, and adrenal cortical neoplasms in male mice — healthspan/pathology prior without Sglt2-abolish residual arm.
Residual-positive canagliflozin lifespan or healthspan H2H under SGLT2 genetic LOF or matched SGLT2-block is explicitly UNKNOWN — no such experiment has been performed.
Longevity-class necessity AGAINST residual is also UNKNOWN — no paper showing Sglt2 KO abolishes canagliflozin lifespan benefit has been found.
The proposed prediction gate is: block-arm early healthspan/metabolic improvement retains ≥50% of SGLT2-intact canagliflozin vs vehicle early healthspan/metabolic improvement on the same panel.
Execution status is NOT_RUN; estimated time to refute is 6 weeks; kill cost tier is 2; IP class is sglt2-insufficiency.
Prior art is classified as PARTIAL: phenotype longevity/healthspan + Sglt2 KO metabolic tool found; residual-positive H2H absent; off-panel HF/renal SGLT2-independent data do not satisfy the claim.
L1–L23 (prior hypothesis cards) do not prove L24; soft-complete empty ≠ novelty / ≠ failure; SGLT2 ≠ bulk ATG, mitophagy, AMPK, or GSK3.
